promise: Player feedback shapes Wildforge. AI helps read suggestions and prepare fixes and features. Changes are tested before they enter a build. Not every suggestion will be implemented.

entries.title: Florist: a living garden
entries.detail: Footsteps plant flowers. Pollen, roots, healing nectar and chain blooms replace turret shooting.

entries.title: Creative achievements
entries.detail: Replace kill-count ladders with exploration, combinations, economy tricks and boss challenges.

entries.title: Cartoon world and natural announcer
entries.detail: Replace photographic art with original cartoon models. Replace robotic system speech with a natural female neural voice.

entries.title: Native Godot version
entries.detail: Three explorable worlds, limited weapon slots and a cohesive bright cartoon world. Photographic realism was abandoned after player feedback.

entries.title: Standalone feedback sharing
entries.detail: Share feedback without a store account. Local suggestions and manual feedback imports work now; automatic online sharing is planned.
